## Walkthrough

Adds two new test modules (sdk/jam/accumulate-item.test.ts and sdk/jam/service.test.ts) that implement roundtrip encode/decode and tagged-encoding tests for accumulate-related types (WorkExecResult, Operand, PendingTransfer, RefineArgs, AccumulateArgs, Response). Introduces TESTS exports in both test modules and a bytes32 helper; registers the new suites in the test runner (sdk/test/test-run.ts) so they run with existing tests.

## Comment by @coderabbitai[bot]

These tests currently bypass the public parse path by reading raw fields directly from `Decoder`, so regressions in `.parse(ptr, len)` would not be detected.

As per coding guidelines, `sdk/jam/**/*.ts`: RefineArgs and AccumulateArgs should be parsed with `.parse(ptr, len)` and encoded with `.encode(e)`.
